  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Game Programming [CSE-4067]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                 Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              Explain the difference between the functions start() and update() with example  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Recall Unity Game Engine architecture with a neat diagram                                    (5)  
  2)              How the exchange of luck and skill ensure balance in the game?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the scripting of characters in unity                                                 (5)  
  3)              Create a family game using game design atoms and explain it significance  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain about scripting collision events in unity                                            (5)  
  4)              What is the anticipation of decisions? Why is it important for players to anticipate what  
  will happen next in skill-based games?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         Explain the role of chance in the game                                                       (5)  
  5)              Illustrate the strategies can designers use to overcome designer's block. Describe  
  methods to generate new ideas or regain creativity when feeling stuck  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)         How to manage the difficult levels by means of tuning                                        (5)  
  
  -----End-----
